_comment: DiagnoseMe editions (build-time product flavors), the single source of truth of the edition list. Read by src/server/editions.py (the server only adds its services table), tools/edition_info.py (build-diagnoseme.sh, cloudbuild, deb/ISO builders, tools/promote.sh) and checked against the Angular edition files, angular.json and Dockerfile.base by src/server/tests/unit/test_editions.py. Every build names its edition explicitly (there is no default edition). docker_tag_aliases are moved together with the edition tag by tools/promote.sh, the only way to promote a release (servo-dolos: :release, the tag of the stations installed before the editions). station_tag is the image tag of the edition's stations (config.env DOCKER_TAG, default the edition id; servo-dolos stations keep following :release). deb_package is the station package; the edition packages conflict with / replace each other. iso_latest is the GCS name of the edition's latest ISO (default custom-debian-preseed-<edition>-latest.iso). Maui editions (maui_utils) bundle the stable maui-utils release (gs://maui-firmware/docker/<version>/stable.dockertag); firmware lists the components of /var/lib/diagnoseme/firmware and maui_device the device of their stable markers (tools/maui_fw_fetch.py); the ISO and offline bundle of an edition fail unless every firmware_stable_required component has a valid STABLE.json (stations refuse several images without one); results_dir is the Maui results directory of the station (DIAGNOSEME_RESULTS_DIR); maui_hw_rev is the Maui hardware revision of the server hooks. realtek_tools marks the editions with the Servo v4p1 tooling (their Dockerfile.base target uses rtk-tools-builder): only their debs ship rtunicpg, the RTL8153 EEPROM files and the r8152 DKMS driver (dist/rtunicpg.tar.bz2, dist/r8152-2.21.4.tar.bz2, fetched by tools/fetch_rtk_tools.sh) and depend on dkms.
